info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Loan Details Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about loans associated with specific customer accounts. With this endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive loan data based on a unique customer ID and account ID. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, customer service representatives, and analysts who need to obtain detailed loan metrics for assessment and reporting purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, typical consumers can streamline loan information retrieval, enhancing the efficiency of financial management operations.

get.summary: Retrieve loan details for a specific account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about loans associated with a given customer account. You can use this data to analyze loan statuses, repayment schedules, and other financial metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve loan details for a specific account under a specific customer. Clients should ensure that all necessary parameters are properly included to get accurate loan information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved loan details for the specified account.
